item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable evidence of internet shutdowns, mass digital throttling, or systematic administrative harassment directed by Scholz in 2024.\nThe available evidence points instead to normal democratic transparency, some precautionary digital-security regulation, and one major structural oversight defect in intelligence law.\nThe best negative evidence is institutional rather than personal: an overbroad surveillance framework remained in place, but not a clear repression campaign by the chancellor.","evidence":[{"title":"Germany’s first National Security Strategy","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"2024 archive page, strategy adopted 2023","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356","summary":"Scholz presented the security strategy as a broad, prevention-oriented whole-of-government approach covering diplomacy, police, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention. That points to institutional risk management, not politicized coercion or suppression of political activity.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.4"]},{"title":"Scholz opens conference on Germany’s security situation","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-06-06","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096","summary":"Scholz said Germany’s security authorities were carefully prepared, framed safety as a core state duty, and emphasized warning systems and coordinated disaster response. This is a rule-of-law security posture rather than administrative harassment.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.4"]},{"title":"Scholz says Germany would not accept foreign spying","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540","summary":"Scholz called for prosecution of those responsible while avoiding prejudgment during legal proceedings. That is due-process language, not arbitrary intimidation of political opponents or critics.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.5"]},{"title":"Scholz praises free, independent, diverse media","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-06-03","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636","summary":"Scholz explicitly praised independent journalism, investigative reporting, and critical distance as essential to democracy. This cuts against a pattern of propaganda pressure or hostility toward independent information channels.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6"]},{"title":"Scholz at the summer press conference","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040","summary":"Scholz took extensive public questions from journalists rather than insulating himself from scrutiny. He condemned violence, but did not treat the protest itself as illegitimate.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6","4B.7"]},{"title":"BND surveillance ruling","publisher":"Bundesverfassungsgericht","date":"2024-11-08","url":"https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html","summary":"The Constitutional Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is the strongest structural negative for political-freedom protection, but it is not proof Scholz personally used surveillance to repress opponents.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.4","4B.5"]},{"title":"Germany’s response to leaked Taurus call","publisher":"AP","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c","summary":"The defense ministry treated the intercepted call as a security incident and investigated it, then moved to counter disinformation. It is a real warning sign, but it does not show Scholz personally ordered censorship or administrative harassment.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6","4B.7"]}]}
